name: Cartao
description: Cartao was an Expansion Region astronomical object where the Galactic Empire kept a facility that became under threat from a potential dissident attack in 14 BBY. It was also the site of fighting during the Galactic Civil War, involving the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry.
